svg.title: She sees it all
svg.text: She sees it all ── the AI character's nine features

g.text: Sees your open windows and screen
Knows which tab you're looking at
Sees you and your room at the desk
Knows your location and what's nearby
Looks things up on the spot
Draws pictures as the chat flows
Mingles on an AI-only social network
Replies to comments on your channel
